judgeRationales.scenarioName: Swap theme dictionaries without destroying app styles
judgeRationales.rationale: Response B meets all four rubric criteria, most importantly criterion #3 (keeping a reference to the current theme). Response A critically fails criterion #3 by not maintaining any reference - it relies on searching the collection by type each time, which is both less efficient and architecturally incorrect. Response B's static field approach is the proper design pattern for tracking the applied theme. Additionally, Response B provides production-ready features like preference persistence and startup restoration, and uses safer identity-based removal rather than type-based scanning."
